# Elastomeric Insights: Elastomer Material Selection Resources, Delivered


*Published by Rogers Corporation [Elastomeric Material Solutions](https://www.rogerscorp.com/blog?qsBlogSection={951CE41D-76AB-4377-9060-5F437C222DD7})*


Rogers Corporation regularly publishes new technical content, from articles on compression set and gasket design to material-selection tools and application stories.


Designed specifically for engineers and technical professionals who work with elastomeric materials, Elastomeric Insights is our free email newsletter that brings together a selection of our most useful resources in each edition.


## What Is Included in Elastomeric Insights?


Each edition focuses on a technical topic related to elastomer material selection, performance, or application design. You will also find an Engineer’s Pick, featuring a tool, guide, article, or other resource that our team thinks is especially helpful.


Topics may include:


- Elastomer material selection and performance
- Gasket design and sealing
- Compression set and stress relaxation
- Temperature and environmental exposure
- Specifications and industry standards
- Testing and common failure modes
- New materials, tools, and application ideas


We keep each edition short and focused. You can scan the highlights, explore the resources that apply to your work, and save the rest for when you need it.


## More Context for Material Decisions


A technical datasheet can help narrow your material options, but it does not always answer every application question.


How will the material behave after years under compression? What happens when temperature, moisture, or chemicals are involved? How could adhesive selection or manufacturing tolerances affect the finished part?


Elastomeric Insights delivers resources that explore questions like those above and helps connect material properties with real design considerations. Whether you are choosing an elastomer for a new application, troubleshooting an existing design, or just trying to stay up to date, the Elastomeric Insights makes it easier to find useful technical information from Rogers.


Sign up for Elastomeric Insights and get the latest elastomer material-selection resources delivered to your inbox.
